title: PURSUE Release 1 - official record index (all 161 records: documents, videos, images)
doc_notes: This document is an official index of 161 records released by the Department of War, containing numerous reports of UAP encounters by military and government personnel.

encounters.summary: A U.S. military operator reported observing a solid white object making erratic movements above the water in the Persian Gulf.
A U.S. military operator reported observing a formation of unknown flying objects traveling along the coast of the Persian Gulf.
A U.S. military operator reported observing a round, cold object over the Gulf of Aden, making abrupt directional changes.
A U.S. military operator reported observing two balloon-shaped, metallic, reflective objects, with one circling the other.
Seven federal government employees reported observing orbs launching other orbs, a large stationary glowing orb, and a translucent kite-like phenomenon in the western United States.
Eyewitnesses reported an ellipsoid bronze metallic object materializing out of a bright light, 130-195 feet in length.
A U.S. military operator reported observing a diamond-shaped UAP with a non-maneuvering probe at the bottom over the Mediterranean Sea.
A senior U.S. intelligence official reported finding a super-hot orb hovering over the ground after a helicopter search, followed by a swarm of lights and multiple orbs flaring.
encounters.quote: super-hot orb hovering over the ground
